articles.title: XRP sentiment falls to 8-month low, and that has been a buy signal before
articles.snippet: Santiment's weighted sentiment gauge for XRP just hit its weakest reading since October 2025. The firm notes the token's strongest rebounds have tended to start when the crowd was this checked out.

articles.title: Monero price rockets 33% to $438 amid $120 million onchain laundering maze
articles.snippet: Onchain sleuth ZachXBT traced remaining funds across exchanges, instant swap services and other blockchains. Tether later froze $72 million in USDT linked to the activity.

articles.title: International sting shuts down $390M crypto money-laundering ring
articles.snippet: Eleven countries were involved in the joint operation that ended the AudiA6 crypto laundering ring and Dark2Web marketplace.

articles.title: Audiera’s AI token BEAT beats Bitcoin, Ethereum as price surges 1,500% in a month
articles.snippet: BEAT has reached its most overbought readings on record, raising the odds of a 35% price decline in the coming days.

articles.title: Ripple CEO Takes Aim at JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon Over Clarity Act Crypto Bill Criticism
articles.snippet: Ripple's Brad Garlinghouse spoke out against JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon and his comments on the key piece of crypto legislation.
